dct_title_s: Decatur County, Iowa, 1967, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol AJE. Form of individual image numbering: AJE-1HH-[number], AJE-2HH-[number], or AJE-3HH-[number]. "Year Flown 1967". Flown by Utility Data Corporation, Kansas City, MO. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
